scope: Corollary 5.2 (Prediction from a nearby contour) of the manuscript “Buffered comparison and stopping-band resolution in critical Ising” (preprints/Buffered-comparison-and-stopping-band-resolution-in-critical-Ising-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d5167e3fe5fb85f4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the setting of Proposition 5.1, let F be a sigma-field containing the spins of J′ s, and write PF X = E[X | F]. Then lim sup s→∞ ∥MJs − PF MJs ∥2 ≤ C0(w/s)3/8 . (5.2) The normalization on the approximating sum remains s−7/8 even when the two contours have different lengths.
